newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco Andina mine expansion ahead of schedule.
newsitem.headline: Codelco Andina mine expansion ahead of schedule.

text.p: Building work on the expansion of Chilean state copper company Codelco's Andina division is running two months ahead of schedule and may be completed in mid-1998, said a top Codelco official.

The expansion, which will increase Andina's output to 220,000 tonnes a year, may come into operation in July 1998 instead of September as planned, development vice-president Juan Enrique Morales told a news conference.
Andina, Codelco's third largest division, produced 146,000 tonnes of copper last year.
